subject: Renewal + Vendor Reboarding: procurement portal steps and PO walkthrough
messages:
From: Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@nimbusretail.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@nimbusretail.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Upcoming renewal + vendor onboarding refresh (timing & docs)

Hi Mina —

We’re coming up on our annual renewal for the Redwood contract (line item: inference capacity + dedicated pool). Procurement asked that we re-run vendor credentialing and confirm the updated SOW before we issue a PO. Attaching their standard recert form and the SOW you sent in August (we made a few inline suggestions).

Two asks from our side:
- Can you confirm Redwood’s preferred PO cadence (single annual PO vs quarterly top-ups)?
- Can your team walk procurement through the ProcureFlow portal for evidence upload? They want a short checklist and an expected timeline for credentialing sign-off so they can lock the renewal window.

We’d like to avoid a hard stop on Nov 20th when our current commitment lapses. Can you propose a short runway and a safety-net approach (temporary capacity bridge or partial PO) we can present?

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Sarah
Vendor Operations | Nimbus Retail
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@nimbusretail.com>, procure@nimbusretail.com
Date: 2026-11-01T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + vendor onboarding refresh (timing & docs)

Thanks Sarah — looping in Jordan and Irene to own the portal + SOW updates. Quick plan below; Jordan, can you confirm ETA?

Summary of asks from Nimbus:
- Preferred PO cadence: Sarah asked for guidance (we support annual POs and staged quarterly top-ups).
- Portal walkthrough: ProcureFlow evidence checklist + expected turnaround.
- Safety-net: propose temporary capacity bridge (30% carry) or invoice credit to prevent service interruption.

Proposed next steps (internal owners):
1) Jordan: assemble a one-page ProcureFlow checklist and short video (5 min) showing evidence upload flow — target: 48 hours.
2) Irene: update SOW to reflect term extension option + temporary capacity bridge clause; create a redline for Nimbus to review — target: EOD tomorrow.
3) Mina: coordinate with legal for a one-off PO template (pre-filled with terms) and send to Sarah for procurement OK.

Attachments from Nimbus included: Nimbus_SOW_v3.pdf, vendor_recert_form.xlsx (procurement recert). Marking as has_attachments.

Jordan/Irene — please include specific field names Nimbus needs for ProcureFlow (e.g., SOC 2 attestation PDF, KMS certificate, vendor org chart).

I’ll propose a fallback timeline we can present to Nimbus if we don’t get full evidence by Nov 15th (short runway to avoid hard stop).

— Mina
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@nimbusretail.com>, Avery Dunn <avery.dunn@consulting-partner.io>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + vendor onboarding refresh (timing & docs)

Quick status update and ProcureFlow checklist (draft):

ProcureFlow checklist (draft)
- Company registration (W9 / company registration docs)
- SOC 2 Type II attestation (PDF)
- Data processing addendum signed (DPA.pdf)
- Encryption/KMS statement (short form)
- Primary contact + billing contact (name, email, phone)
- SOW signed, version noted (SOW v3)
- PO number (once Procure approves)
- Bank details / remittance info

Turnaround expectations:
- If Nimbus uploads all items in ProcureFlow: procurement can typically finish verification in 3 business days.
- If any attestation needs follow-up (legal review or KMS review): add 5 business days.

Safety-net options we can present to Nimbus:
A) Capacity bridge: temporary 30% capacity carry for up to 21 days post-commitment lapse (invoice for consumed carry with final reconciliation).
B) Short-term invoice credit: Redwood invoices at current committed rate and holds capacity pending PO (requires finance sign-off).

Deliverables and owners (ETA):
- ProcureFlow one-pager + 5-min walkthrough video (Jordan) — 48 hours (2026-11-04 COB).
- SOW redline (Irene) — 24 hours (2026-11-02 EOD).
- Pre-filled PO template (Mina/legal) — 48 hours.

I’m also adding a HubSpot touch: created deal NR-2026-089 and dropped the checklist link into the record (link shared below).

— Jordan
Renewals Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@nimbusretail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T12:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + vendor onboarding refresh (timing & docs)

Thanks — checklist looks right. A couple quick clarifications from procurement:
- They need the SOC 2 PDF and KMS certificate uploaded by Nov 10th to hit their internal approval on Nov 15th.
- They prefer a single annual PO but will approve quarterly top-ups if we provide a reconciliatory clause.

Also looping in Avery (procurement consultant) — Avery, we may route some evidence through the consulting partner for faster ingestion.

We’ll review the SOW redline once Irene shares it; if you can include explicit language for the temporary bridge (option A) that will help move procurement faster.

Sarah
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@nimbusretail.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T16:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + vendor onboarding refresh (timing & docs)

All — final confirmations:
- Irene attached SOW_redline_Nov03.pdf to the HubSpot deal and included the temporary capacity bridge clause (30% for 21 days) and a reconciliation paragraph for quarterly top-ups.
- Jordan’s ProcureFlow one-pager and walkthrough video released (links in HubSpot).
- Legal approved a pre-filled PO template; I’ve uploaded a DocuSign-ready version and a quick checklist for procurement to use.

Next asks for Nimbus (requested today):
1) Upload SOC 2 Type II PDF + KMS statement into ProcureFlow by 2026-11-10.
2) Confirm preferred PO cadence (annual vs quarterly top-ups).
3) If they want the bridge, confirm via a short signed acknowledgement (DocuSign) so finance can provision the temporary carry.

If Nimbus confirms the bridge by Nov 6th, we’ll lock the safety-net and avoid any interruption when the current commitment lapses on Nov 20th.

Thanks everyone — I’ll coordinate follow-ups in HubSpot (NR-2026-089) and circle back if we need to escalate.

— Mina
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
